name: workday-mcp
description: Read-only Workday access for Claude — fetch your tasks, pay, benefits and compensation data through your signed-in session

tenant.title: Workday tenant
tenant.description: Your Workday tenant slug — the path segment after the host, e.g. for https://wd5.myworkday.com/acme it is `acme`.

host.title: Workday host
host.description: Your Workday data-center host. Defaults to wd5.myworkday.com.

debug.title: Debug logging
debug.description: Set to 1 to log verbose request detail to stderr.

tools.name: workday_healthcheck
tools.description: Verify the fetchproxy bridge + Workday session end-to-end

tools.name: workday_get_apps
tools.description: List your Workday apps with a launchable task id — the discovery entry point

tools.name: workday_open_app
tools.description: Open one of your Workday apps by name and read it, following the hub down to its child cards

tools.name: workday_get_task
tools.description: Read a Workday task or data card by path or task id — title, fields, references

tools.name: workday_get_org_chart
tools.description: Read the reporting chain around you — titles, locations, and profile links

tools.name: workday_get_worker
tools.description: Read a worker profile's catalog of readable sections and tasks, within your own Workday permissions

tools.name: workday_get_worker_task
tools.description: Open one named item on a worker profile, such as Compensation or Job Details

tools.name: workday_get_my_profile
tools.description: Read your own worker profile catalog — pay, benefits, time off, goals, feedback

tools.name: workday_fetch
tools.description: GET any Workday data endpoint and return its raw JSON with secrets redacted (read-only escape hatch)

tools.name: workday_graphql
tools.description: Run a read-only GraphQL query against Workday's PEX surface, with secret/PII fields redacted

tools.name: workday_get_team
tools.description: List the people on the teams you manage, with worker ids, positions and profile links

tools.name: workday_get_reviews
tools.description: List a worker's performance reviews, or open one in full: ratings, manager and employee comments, goals

tools.name: workday_get_feedback
tools.description: Read the feedback a worker has received, given, or requested

tools.name: workday_get_feedback_status
tools.description: Check on every feedback request you made: who has answered and who is still to

tools.name: workday_get_request_form
tools.description: Load a request type's form (e.g. promotion consideration) and list its questions and required fields, without creating a request

tools.name: workday_get_team_snapshot
tools.description: One table of everyone in your organization: grade, job profile, last promotion, rating, pay

tools.name: workday_get_inbox
tools.description: List the tasks waiting in your Workday inbox (review comments, feedback requests, approvals), or your archive

tools.name: workday_get_my_requests
tools.description: List the Workday requests you created, such as promotion consideration forms, with their status

tools.name: workday_get_request
tools.description: List your open requests (e.g. promotion forms you started), or read one with its saved answers

tools.name: workday_update_request
tools.description: Change answers on an open request and Save for Later or Submit it — confirmation-token gated, verified by re-read

tools.name: workday_get_benefits
tools.description: Your current benefit elections with coverage, dependents, beneficiaries and per-pay-period cost; or your dependents, beneficiaries, election history

tools.name: workday_get_benefit_enrollment
tools.description: Read an open enrollment event without changing it: deadline, next year's cost changes, every plan on offer with prices

tools.name: workday_update_benefit_enrollment
tools.description: Write. Choose or waive plans and set HSA/FSA amounts in an open enrollment, then Save for Later or sign and Submit — confirmation-gated, verified by re-read

tools.name: workday_run_report
tools.description: Run a Workday report by task id, URL or dashboard name, setting its prompts, and return its rows

tools.name: workday_get_dashboard
tools.description: Open a dashboard (e.g. Year End Dashboard): its worklets and report links, optionally running each worklet

tools.name: workday_give_feedback
tools.description: Write. Give a colleague feedback, optionally with a badge — confirmation-gated, verified by re-read

tools.name: workday_request_feedback
tools.description: Write. Ask colleagues for feedback on yourself or one of your reports, with a template and/or your own questions — confirmation-gated
